name: CE_STMT_HDR_TOTALS_INT
description: CE_STMT_HDR_TOTALS_INT contains information about statement header totals interface.

columns.name: STMT_HDR_TOTALS_INT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the statement header totals interface.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: STATEMENT_HEADER_INT_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to bank statement header interface.

columns.name: NUM_OF_ENTRIES
columns.description: Total number of lines reported on the statement.

columns.name: SUM_OF_ENTRIES
columns.description: Sum of the total number of lines reported on the statement.

columns.name: TOTAL_NET_AMT
columns.description: Net amount of the credits and totals on the statement.

columns.name: DEBIT_CREDIT_IND
columns.description: Identifies whether the amount is positive (credit) or negative (debit).

columns.name: TOTAL_CR_ENTRIES
columns.description: Total credit entries on the statement.

columns.name: TOTAL_DR_ENTRIES
columns.description: Total debit entries reported on the statement.

columns.name: TOTAL_CR_SUM
columns.description: Total credit amount reported in the statement.

columns.name: TOTAL_DR_SUM
columns.description: Total debit amount reported on the statement.

columns.name: DOMAIN
columns.description: Specifies the domain, the family and the subfamily of the bank transaction code, in a structure.

columns.name: FAMILY
columns.description: Specifies the family and the subfamily of the bank transaction code, within a specific domain, in a structure.

columns.name: SUB_FAMILY
columns.description: Specifies the subproduct family within a specific family.

columns.name: TRX_CODE
columns.description: Transaction code associated with the totals.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
